messages:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident INC-2026-4555 - High urgency. Trigger: az6 networking spike -> 503s from model-serving cluster in ap-southeast. Page fired to oncall (5867890123)
incident-bot: automated page fired to #incidents and oncall. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/az-failover. Logs collector will attach snapshots automatically.
alice (oncall): ack
alice (oncall): seeing elevated 5xx across route groups for az6. Control-plane heartbeats flaky, lots of kube-proxy resets.
ben-sre: on my way, pulling vRouter and fabric logs now.
carla-support: fyi flagged to CSMs. Customers reporting increased latency and intermittent failures; one banking customer reports ~15% error-rate.
devon-platform: can we divert traffic off az6 to az7/az8? What's current headroom?
ezra-sre-lead: recommend divert + short autoscale. If errors persist after diversion, trigger full fallback (cross-az failover).
alice (oncall): initiating diversion now
```bash
# trigger cross-az divert
redwoodctl routing divert --from az6 --to az7,az8 --policy emergency --reason "az6 nic degrade"
```
alice (oncall): routing change accepted, propagating to edge.
incident-bot: routing change detected; drain of az6 started. Estimated initial RTO 6m. Telemetry: reroute requests -> 30% to az7, 70% to az8 (gradual).
pagerduty: INC-2026-4555 acknowledged by alice (oncall)
ben-sre: NIC flaps visible on fabric switches, repeated ASIC errors at 14:03. Correlating with spike. Opening vendor ticket TICKET-7893.
carla-support: preparing short customer-facing note: "We are experiencing a networking fault in ap-southeast AZ6 impacting some requests. Traffic has been diverted; we expect a reduction in errors within minutes." Will post to status page.
devon-platform: verifying backend capacity in az7/az8. Spinning additional serving instances for high-memory models.
alice (oncall): monitoring - error-rate dropping 18% -> 5% since diversion. Latency improving on median p95.
ezra-sre-lead: good. Keep diversion for now. Plan: maintain diversion 30m, vendor triage in parallel. If stable, we'll keep diverted and schedule maintenance window.
carla-support: posted update to status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-4555 with current mitigation actions. Link included in customer comms.
alice (oncall): handing off long-run investigation to ben-sre (ben you are L1 now)
ben-sre: taking over. Capturing tcpdumps and diag snapshots to s3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-4555/
ben-sre: immediate next steps: vendor triage, gather config diffs, consider rolling NIC firmware rollback if vendor suggests.
pagerduty: incident reassigned to ben-sre
alice (oncall): leaving rotation, thanks team — monitoring channel muted for my rotation.
ben-sre: collecting pcap + dmesg. Sample command: ```sudo tcpdump -w /tmp/az6-flap.pcap host 10.2.3.4 and port 443``` then upload.
ben-sre: snapshot uploaded. initiating vendor call in 10m.
carla-support: direct notifications sent to top 3 affected customers (acct:bank-ops, ecom-plus, social-prod). Will update if ETA changes.
ezra-sre-lead: define mitigation complete criteria: 30m stable post-diversion and region-wide error-rate <1%. If criteria met, mark mitigated and schedule postmortem.
incident-bot: autopager rule active: escalate to oncall-lead if error-rate >5% persists for additional 10m.
ben-sre: vendor confirmed intermittent ASIC error on NIC batch. Replacement recommended. Planning maintenance window; will coordinate with support and infra.
carla-support: preparing final customer note to be sent when status -> "monitoring".
ben-sre: status update: mitigation successful, error-rate trending <1.5% after 18m. Keeping diversion until replacement scheduled.
alice (oncall): :thumbsup: nice work
ben-sre: will document timeline and RCA for postmortem. Closing handoff to ezra for PM on follow-up.
ezra-sre-lead: acknowledged. Assigning postmortem owner and linking runbook.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-4555 marked mitigated (partial) at 5867890289. Follow-up tasks created: (1) vendor NIC replace; (2) update runbooks for faster cross-az divert; (3) customer comms wrap-up.
carla-support: thanks team, will coordinate customer wrap-up and postmortem notes. 
ben-sre: logging final artifacts in ops/incident/INC-2026-4555/ and will attach timeline + graphs.
alice (oncall): signing off for rotation.
